name: BetaTesting

sources.title: BetaTesting (ErliBird Nest, Inc.) — commercial beta-testing/user-research platform; 'Get Started' > /signup; Pricing page exists; ID-verified tester pool; SOC2/GDPR badges; G2 Leader

conditions: Not a directory — this is a paid beta-testing service; you pay to recruit ID-verified testers for your product; a Pricing page exists and 'Get Started' leads to /signup, but it produces no listing
requirements: A product in testable shape and a testing budget
Signup at betatesting.com/signup; paid plans (Professional includes test-planning assistance; fully managed services available)
Test types: single-session, multi-day/journal, IHUT, global QA (200+ countries), load tests, game playtesting, AI human feedback
Tester side is separate: 'Join as Beta Tester' recruits participants
preparation: Test plan: what to test, target tester demographics, duration
Budget — this is a paid service
workflow: Sign up and configure a test (or schedule a call for managed service)
Recruit from the vetted tester pool with targeting criteria
Collect structured feedback, usability videos, QA reports
watchFor: Catalog fit is a stretch — this produces user research, not a public listing or backlink
Useful pre-launch (real feedback), but counts as zero 'launch coverage'
countsAsLive: Nothing public is created — this yields private testing feedback, not a listing
